cars.name: Aston Martin AMR23
cars.modifications: R3 editable-source exterior reconstruction: continuous bodywork, thin multi-element wings, fitted atlas livery, baked carbon/rubber PBR, rigid suspension kinematics; original supplied GLB retained in the working project. | preview.24: structural fixes (detached parts reattached, plank/spokes extended, mirror assemblies seated, rear wing span to ~1.23 m per 2022+ rules), see 更新说明.
